summary.text: Tyler Price is the Democratic candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 69, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Sheila Dills in an open-seat race.

paragraphs.text: Tyler Price graduated from Bolivar High School and the Franklin Technology Center in 2015.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a licensed nurse with over 10 years of experience serving seniors and families in Oklahoma and currently works as a Director of Nursing in assisted living.

He said he is a husband and father of three, and listed his priorities as health care access and affordability, workforce development, public education, support for working families and responsible government spending.
